subject: Existing male batter, rebuilt for catcher-side umpire view

reference.title: Best of Ump Cam from Game 2

observations.observation: Original 46-second clip paused in its umpire-camera segment. Batter loaded on camera-left, lead knee raised; catcher occupies lower-right. Torso can turn enough to reveal chest, and head is at upper frame edge.
Same segment after the swing. Broad jersey back and rear helmet dominate, face hidden; rear foot near camera and lead foot deeper toward mound, home plate to batter's right.

reference.interpretation: Fixed game camera uses a rear/right-shoulder three-quarter batter. Face mostly hidden by helmet and orientation; body visibility varies during swing. This is visual reference, not biomechanical motion capture.

changes: Eleven newly drawn same-camera body poses plus a complete separate wooden bat; card images preserved.
Native rear/lead foot, grip and bat landmarks registered by observed source pixels.
Strict rear-view-only idle, take, swing, bunt, finish, regrip and reset.
Uniform field/actor camera fitting prevents squash at small heights.
limits: Eleven painted body keys with local mesh interpolation, not frame-by-frame 60fps art.
Source registration and camera observations are manual approximations.
Commercial art polish and perceived naturalness require player review; test counts do not prove them.
